scope: Actual native local-view integration contract using an isolated Windows profile store and embedded xlang3 SQLite.
scenario: An existing workspace profile started with an OpenAI provider from the shared YAML file.
The YAML file then gained a Claude profile while the native backend remained running.
The local browser view attached that existing workspace and exposed both profile IDs.
A new workspace attached afterward also received both profiles.
limitations: A browser view already open when the YAML is edited does not watch the file; reopen the xMind view to reapply it.
No live provider inference or installed webpage acceptance was performed.
